Responsibilities

descriptions.job-11pe14k:
GoMining is a Bitcoin cloud-mining platform that has grown into a full crypto ecosystem: Digital Miners, the GOMINING token, GoMining Card, Wallet, Simple Earn, the VIP programme and Miner Wars. We’re growing fast and plan to multiply sales next year. A large part of that growth will come from partners who already have big audiences.

This role brings those partners in across Europe. We’re hiring one BDM per region, and this position covers the European market. You’ll find and sign affiliates and partners with large networks in Europe: crypto exchanges and media, iGaming operators and affiliate networks, brokers, fintech players, streamers and influencer agencies. Our offer to them is one of the strongest on the market: a high commission on every sale their audience makes, plus a lifetime revenue share. Your job is to put that offer in front of the right people and close the deal.

This is not a desk job and not mass cold outreach. You’ll spend much of your time in the field, at conferences, expos and meetings across Europe, holding live negotiations every day. You’ll be one of the first members of a regional BD team we’re building from scratch. Your income grows directly with the volume your partners bring in, and the bonus is uncapped.

What you’ll do

Hunting: find the partners who matter

  • Map the partners with the biggest reach in Europe: crypto (exchanges, wallets, media, communities), iGaming and gambling (operators, affiliate networks, streamers), brokers (forex, CFD, investment platforms), fintech and payments, large media and influencer agencies.
  • Work the field: attend crypto, iGaming, affiliate and fintech conferences across Europe, book meetings in advance and close partnerships on site.
  • Use your own network and local reputation to get in front of decision-makers, not just whoever answers an email.

Closing: run the full cycle

  • Own every deal end to end: first contact, negotiation, agreeing terms, onboarding, launching traffic and the first sales.
  • Negotiate with founders and senior management, and show clearly what partnering with GoMining is worth to them and their audience.
  • When a partner says no, find out why and bring that back so we can sharpen the offer.

Growing: turn partners into volume

  • Grow the partners you’ve signed: higher volume, new formats, and special offers for their audiences.
  • Keep your pipeline up to date in the CRM, report weekly on the funnel, and file a short results report after every trip.
  • Share what you see in the European market (competitor offers, partner expectations, local payment specifics) with the team.

What success looks like

  • First month: you know the product and the partner offer inside out, your Europe pipeline is mapped, and your conference and meeting calendar for the next quarter is set.
  • First 3 months: you’re running a steady rhythm of in-person meetings, your first partnerships are signed and live, and the first sales are coming in through your partners.
  • Ongoing: we measure you on new active partners per month, sales volume and revenue from those partners, and how well your meetings convert into signed deals.
  • 3+ years in business development, partnerships or affiliate management in crypto, iGaming, gambling, brokerage or fintech.
  • Your own network in Europe (affiliates, networks, operators, media). This is the main requirement.
  • A track record of closing large partnership deals, with numbers you can walk us through.
  • Confidence negotiating with founders and senior management.
  • Readiness to travel a lot to conferences and meetings across Europe.
  • A hunter mindset: proactive, fast-paced, driven by results and money.
  • Fluent English.

Would be a plus

  • A European language beyond English: German, Spanish, Italian, French, Polish or another language of the region.
  • A personal reputation in the local crypto, affiliate or iGaming community.
  • A strong grasp of affiliate models (CPA, RevShare, hybrid) and traffic.
  • Experience with large affiliate networks and streamers.
  • Knowledge of payment specifics in European markets.
  • Sales-driven pay: a fixed salary plus an uncapped bonus on the sales volume your partners bring in.
  • A travel and conference budget for field work across Europe.
  • Fast decisions and direct access to the head of the direction.
  • Professional growth: support for courses, conferences, and English learning (up to 100% coverage).
  • Work-life fit: remote format with flexible hours across international teams.
  • Paid leave: up to 20 vacation days + 8 company holidays + 5 personal days per year.
  • Team culture: retreats in international locations (for example, company apartments in Cyprus).

As an AI Application Backend Engineer, you will be a core builder of AI engineering capabilities — deeply integrating large language models with financial business scenarios to construct the backend AI service layer powering trading intelligence, smart risk control, compliance monitoring, and user services.

DEeP focuses on providing a scalable developer experience that any developer can leverage to accelerate a customer's ability to create value from Stripe.

Within DEeP, the Extensibility program is how Stripe expands its total addressable market, and increases customer retention. With extensibility, Stripe becomes programmable — customers and product teams can adapt Stripe to their needs on a common platform.

Stripe has three interconnected extensibility primitives:

Scripts — Secure, isolated TypeScript runtime allowing merchants and developers to customize Stripe product behavior (e.g., discount calculations, invoice logic, proration).

Custom Objects — User-defined data models (e.g., Shipments, Locations, Warranties, Entitlements) with first-class APIs, SDKs, and Dashboard experiences.

Workflows — A programmable orchestration layer (graduating to GA at Sessions) enabling no-code and pro-code business logic across Stripe, including custom actions, delays, smart retries, and 3P integrations.

These primitives are deeply interdependent, involve 10+ cross-functional teams and culminate in a flagship product launch.

What you’ll do

We are seeking a product-focused Technical Program Manager to drive the Extensibility program across the Workflows, Custom Objects, and Scripts workstreams.
